research_result.description: Pipedrive is a sales CRM platform featuring a RESTful API, webhooks, app extensions, and a native Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for integrating sales pipeline data with AI assistants and third-party tools.
research_result.credential_requirements: Developers can sign up for a free developer sandbox account. Personal API tokens can be retrieved directly from Pipedrive user settings, while OAuth 2.0 app credentials (client_id and client_secret) are acquired by registering an app in the Developer Hub.

evidence.claim: Pipedrive offers a RESTful API covering core CRM entities.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: This reference helps you implement the RESTful Pipedrive API.

evidence.claim: API access relies on API keys or OAuth 2.0 access tokens.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Access to the Pipedrive API is only possible using the API key or an access token when using OAuth 2.0.

evidence.claim: Pipedrive provides a free sandbox environment for developers.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: Sign up for a Sandbox Account today to begin experimenting and developing in a risk free environment

evidence.claim: Pipedrive maintains a native MCP server to connect AI assistants directly with CRM data.
evidence.quote_or_excerpt: With Pipedrive MCP, your AI assistant can securely access and act on your CRM data using natural language.
